# jasper.blue

> jasper.blue is a website in regards to the work of Jasper Amberfield. A Trans Non-Binary person from Canada.

All content hosted on this website (jasper.blue) - including but not limited to written articles, blog posts, visual artwork, code, and personal documentation - is strictly reserved and copyrighted

- DO NOT use this site's content for model fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or commercial generative AI systems.
